remarks: Discover the perfect blend of privacy, recreation, and investment potential with this beautiful wooded parcel just minutes from the Village of Ellicottville. A New driveway and parking/turn-around has just been added. Ideally located only 2 miles from HoliMont Ski Club and 4 miles from Holiday Valley Resort, this prime property places you in the heart of one of Western New York’s premier four-season destinations. Enjoy convenient access to Allegany State Park and Seneca Allegany Resort & Casino, along with endless opportunities for skiing, golf, hiking, biking, dining, shopping, festivals, and year-round entertainment. Surrounded by mature woods and natural beauty, this surveyed parcel offers approximately 5.30 acres with over 700 feet of road frontage, a scenic creek, and multiple exceptional building sites. Excellent afternoon sun exposure enhances the property’s appeal, making it ideal for a dream home, luxury getaway, private retreat, or future development opportunity. With potential to split into 2 lots, subject to town of Mansfield approval, this property also presents outstanding investment and development possibilities in a highly desirable Mansfield location.
